title: Activate the EU TDM reservation by mirroring to an owned domain

completion_criteria.text: Establish what a valid EU Art. 4(3) machine-readable reservation actually requires, and whether self-hosting satisfies it, rather than assuming a mirror is the answer
Decide domain, host and sync mechanism on real numbers - one-off and recurring cost, effort, failure modes - with doing nothing costed honestly as a live option
Serve robots.txt, ai.txt and /.well-known/tdmrep.json from the owned domain, each verified by fetching it over the public internet at its expected path
Keep the mirror from drifting from the repo, with a sync that fails loudly rather than silently serving stale terms
Confirm the reservation is machine-discoverable: correct content types, tdmrep.json valid against its schema, and the canonical location declared from the repo
